symbols.name: last-axis exponent
symbols.meaning: An exponent of $x$ on the last cyclic axis, ranging over $0\le\sigma<r$.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma$ and $\tau$ be exponents on the last axis, with $0\le \sigma,\tau<r$.

symbols.name: second last-axis exponent
symbols.meaning: A second exponent of $x$ on the last cyclic axis, ranging over $0\le\tau<r$.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma$ and $\tau$ be exponents on the last axis, with $0\le \sigma,\tau<r$.

symbols.name: last-axis coefficient
symbols.meaning: The coefficient of $x^\sigma$ in a polynomial on the last axis, indexed by the exponent $\sigma$.
symbols.quote: Applied to a polynomial $\sum_\sigma \xi_\sigma x^\sigma$ with coefficients $\xi_\sigma$, the twist gives $\sum_\sigma \xi_\sigma\lambda^\sigma y^\sigma$: coefficient $\sigma$ is multiplied by $\lambda^\sigma$, and untwisting multiplies it by $\lambda^{-\sigma}$.

symbols.name: cyclic variable
symbols.meaning: The variable of the cyclic ring $\mathbb C[x]/(x^r-1)$ on the last axis, whose exponents wrap modulo $r$.
symbols.quote: Let $x$ be the variable of the cyclic ring $\mathbb C[x]/(x^r-1)$, whose exponents wrap modulo $r$.

symbols.name: twist root
symbols.meaning: A complex number with $\lambda^r=-1$, whose powers rescale the coefficients under the twist.
symbols.quote: Let $\lambda=e^{\pi \mathrm i/r}$, where $\mathrm i$ is the imaginary unit, so $\lambda^r=-1$.

symbols.name: cyclic product index
symbols.meaning: The exponent of the cyclic product, with $0\le\mu<r$, obtained by reducing $\sigma+\tau$ modulo $r$.
symbols.quote: Every sum $\sigma+\tau$ can be written $\sigma+\tau=\mu+\eta r$ with $0\le\mu<r$ and $\eta\in\{0,1\}$, where $\mu$ is the cyclic index of the product and $\eta$ records whether the exponent wrapped.

symbols.name: wrap flag
symbols.meaning: The flag, 0 or 1, recording whether the sum $\sigma+\tau$ wrapped past $r$.
symbols.quote: Every sum $\sigma+\tau$ can be written $\sigma+\tau=\mu+\eta r$ with $0\le\mu<r$ and $\eta\in\{0,1\}$, where $\mu$ is the cyclic index of the product and $\eta$ records whether the exponent wrapped.

symbols.name: first entry
symbols.meaning: An entry on the remaining axes, an element of $\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$ with untwisted coefficients $X_\sigma$.
symbols.quote: Let $X$ and $Y$ be two entries, with untwisted coefficients $X_\sigma$ and $Y_\tau$, so $X=\sum_\sigma X_\sigma\lambda^\sigma y^\sigma$ and $Y=\sum_\tau Y_\tau\lambda^\tau y^\tau$.

symbols.name: second entry
symbols.meaning: A second entry on the remaining axes, an element of $\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$ with untwisted coefficients $Y_\tau$.
symbols.quote: Let $X$ and $Y$ be two entries, with untwisted coefficients $X_\sigma$ and $Y_\tau$, so $X=\sum_\sigma X_\sigma\lambda^\sigma y^\sigma$ and $Y=\sum_\tau Y_\tau\lambda^\tau y^\tau$.

relations.predicate: turns the last cyclic coordinate into
relations.quote: The twist turns the last cyclic coordinate into the [Polynomial ring modulo $y^r+1$](poly-ring-y-r.md).
The twist rescales the coefficients of a [Convolution](convolution.md) so that its cyclic wrap on the last axis becomes a negative wrap in $\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$.
It is applied after [Bluestein's chirp identity](bluestein-chirp.md) has turned the middle transform into a cyclic convolution.
